Core Observation: Many people say they want productivity, but underneath they are often searching for coherence, direction, and relief from internal fragmentation.
Audience Question: Why does productivity advice often stop working after a while?

Topic / Working Title: The difference between information and orientation
Core Observation: People rarely suffer from lack of information alone. More often they lack orientation — the ability to place information into meaningful internal structure.
Audience Question: Why does consuming more information not necessarily create clarity?

Core Observation: Anxiety often intensifies when internal experience remains undefined. Clear language can reduce cognitive fragmentation and restore orientation.
Audience Question: Why do I feel calmer when I can clearly explain what I feel?
